Food+ believes no one need go hungry.

1. Redistribute surplus food and goods from businesses in the Borough of Bromley to those in need, thereby reducing waste.

2. Meet the material needs of individuals across the Borough in financial difficulty.

3. Encourage businesses, organisations and individuals across the Borough to partner with our work.

How it works

  1. Our teams of volunteers collect surplus food and other goods from our partner local businesses.
  2. Local organisations and charities refer clients who are under financial pressure.
  3. We guarantee each client three packages of groceries over three months.
  4. Our four-hour turnaround supplies fresh produce.
  5. We only supply the best quality food, with rigorous food safety systems and training.
